description:
# 🚚 ProxyTransport **High-performance QUIC and TCP transport bridge for Allay and WaterdogPE** ![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg) ![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Version-1.0.0--SNAPSHOT%20%2F%202.1.0--SNAPSHOT-green.svg) ![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-Allay%20%2B%20Waterdog-orange.svg)
[![Русский](https://img.shields.io/badge/Language-Русский-red?style=for-the-badge&logo=google-translate&logoColor=white)](README_RU.md)
--- **ProxyTransport** is a high-performance transport bridge for **Allay** and **WaterdogPE** that forwards Bedrock traffic over **QUIC** or **TCP** without adding an extra gameplay protocol layer. It uses a shared core pipeline, supports Docker service names, and is designed for many backend servers behind one proxy. ### ✨ Features - **QUIC Transport**: Fast downstream connections with bidirectional QUIC streams between WaterdogPE and Allay. - **TCP Transport**: Compatibility fallback for environments where QUIC is not required. - **Shared Core**: One common runtime for framing, compression, codecs, and transport login handling. - **Docker Friendly**: Supports backend addresses like `lobby:19132` and other container service names. - **Operational Safety**: Includes login timeout, packet rate limiting, per-IP connection tracking, and temporary self-signed certificate generation. ### 📦 Modules | Module | Platform | Description | |---------|----------|-------------| | `transport-allay` | Allay | Accepts QUIC proxy connections and forwards them into the Allay network stack. | | `transport-waterdog` | WaterdogPE | Registers `quic` and `tcp` backend types for downstream connections. | | `transport-core` | Shared | Provides the common transport runtime, codecs, framing, compression, and stream handling. | ### 🛠️ Usage 1. **Build the project**: Run `./gradlew build`. 2. **Install the Allay plugin**: Put `ProxyTransport-Allay-1.0.0-SNAPSHOT.jar` from `transport-allay/build/libs` into the Allay `plugins` folder. 3. **Install the WaterdogPE plugin**: Put `ProxyTransport-2.1.0-SNAPSHOT.jar` from `transport-waterdog/build/libs` into the WaterdogPE `plugins` folder. 4. **Configure backend transport**: Use the downstream type `quic` or `tcp` in your WaterdogPE backend configuration. 5. **Start Allay**: If no certificate files exist, ProxyTransport-Allay will generate a temporary self-signed certificate automatically. ### 🚩 Configuration | Option | Default | Description | |------------|-------------|-------------| | `certPath` | `certificates/cert.pem` | Relative path to the QUIC certificate file. | | `keyPath` | `certificates/key.pem` | Relative path to the QUIC private key file. | | `maxStreamsPerConnection` | `4096` | Maximum bidirectional streams per Waterdog connection. | | `connectionLimitPerIp` | `16` | Maximum simultaneous QUIC connections per IP. | | `maxPacketsPerSecond` | `4096` | Maximum packet rate per stream before disconnect. | | `loginTimeoutMs` | `5000` | Time limit in milliseconds for the initial proxy login frame. | ### 🔌 Output Jars | Artifact | Path | Description | |-------|----------|-------------| | `ProxyTransport-Allay-1.0.0-SNAPSHOT.jar` | `transport-allay/build/libs` | Allay plugin. | | `ProxyTransport-2.1.0-SNAPSHOT.jar` | `transport-waterdog/build/libs` | WaterdogPE plugin. | | `transport-core-1.0.0-SNAPSHOT.jar` | `transport-core/build/libs` | Shared internal library module. | ---

Created by Miroshka for Allay and WaterdogPE with ❤️
